Kit summary

Blade OnslaughtBasic
Deals 2 stages of 180% ATK [Burn] DMG each to a single enemy.
Searing BladesActive
Deals 2 stages of 300% ATK [Burn] DMG each to a single enemy. The second stage will inflict [Deep Burn II] on the target for 2 turns.
Scorching SunbeamPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
After McCarty casts skills proactively, he gains 2 layers of [Demonic Blade], up to 5 layers. After other allies cast active skills proactively to enemies, McCarty consumes 1 layer of [Demonic Blade] and casts Blade Onslaught to pursue and attack the main target once. Max Limit of Resonance Points: 20. When a battle starts, McCarty gains 10 points. When an enemy is pursued and attacked by allies, he gains 1 Resonance Point (this effect can be triggered up to 5 times during anyone's turn); if the pursued target is a Boss, McCarty gains 3 Resonance Points. When the Resonance Points reach the max limit, McCarty consumes all of them to enter [Resonance Enhancement] status for 2 turns, during which he cannot gain any Resonance Point.
Demonic Blade of Sun Lv.1McCarty gains 1 layer of [Demonic Blade] after other allies cast active skills. At the beginning of each wave, for every 1 ally with the [Pursue & Attack] tag, McCarty gains 2 Resonance Points and reduces Skill DMG taken by 10%. If there are 5 allies with the [Pursue & Attack] tag, McCarty gains [Demonic Aura]: immune to all control effects.
Demonic Blade of Sun Lv.2McCarty can gain Resonance Points when he is under [Resonance Enhancement] status. After McCarty pursues and attacks each time, he gains 1 layer of [Power of Destruction]: increases self Mastery by 5% and Skill DMG by 2%, up to 30 layers.
Inferno ComboActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 360% ATK [Burn] DMG each to a single enemy (this DMG ignores [Shield]). All of the target's buffs will be removed after the first stage of DMG is dealt.
Demonic Blade of Sun Lv.3McCarty can act for 1 extra turn after he enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for the second time. When McCarty consumes [Demonic Blade] to pursue and attack under [Resonance Enhancement] status, he casts Inferno Combo to pursue and attack the main target once instead.
Source: game files.
